newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Lankhorst debuts at 11.5 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Lankhorst debuts at 11.5 rgt.

text.p: Shares of Lankhorst Bhd debuted on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange at 11.5 ringgit against its offer price of 4.50 ringgit.
The construction and engineering company had offered for sale three million shares and a public issue of three million new shares.
In the first five minutes of trading, the share rose to a high of 12.50 ringgit, before coming down to 12.00 ringgit.
The company has forecast a net profit of 21.29 million ringgit in the year to December 31, 1997, against 6.24 million in the previous year.
The forecast net earnings per share for the current year would be 93 cents per share against 90 cents last year.
At the current price of 11.80 ringgit, the shares are trading at 13.11 times earnings multiple against 4.84 at the offer price.
